title: 瑜伽裤巨头：两年产品失误，降价也难救？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Here to help us break down those Lululemon results as Stacey Widlis. She is president and founder SW Retail Advisors. Stacey, Lululemon has so many things that it needs to fix right now.
segments.zh: 斯泰西·维德利茨是SW零售顾问公司的总裁兼创始人，她来帮我们分析Lululemon的业绩。斯泰西，Lululemon现在有很多问题需要解决。

segments.en: And it doesn't have a CEO yet, a new permanent CEO. She is incoming, Heidi O'Neill.
segments.zh: 而且他们还没有正式的首席执行官，新任CEO海迪·奥尼尔即将上任。

segments.en: Do we have any sense of what her plan has to entail here?
segments.zh: 我们能否了解她的计划必须包含哪些内容？

segments.en: Yeah, this has been, you know, two years of product mistakes. When we first started to see that and started seeing the markdowns in December 2024, we put a cell in the stock and recall
segments.zh: 是的，这已经是两年的产品失误了。当我们开始看到问题，并在2024年12月看到降价时，我们卖出了权益资产，记得两年前股价是500美元。

segments.en: the stock was $500, two years ago. So you're looking at a situation here where product has not been fixed. You're looking at a situation where the competition is skyrocketing with aloe and
segments.zh: 所以现在的情况是产品问题没有解决，竞争激烈，比如Alo和Vuori等品牌。

segments.en: vuary. You're looking at a situation where this brand is trying to be all things to all people.
segments.zh: 这个品牌试图满足所有人的需求。

segments.en: When you go in the stores now, you kind of look around and you feel like there's too much coming at you. It's not focused where the other brands are really focused. So those are some of the things
segments.zh: 现在走进门店，你会觉得信息过载，不够聚焦，而其他品牌则非常专注。

segments.en: going on. And again, we had a CEO announced months ago. We've been waiting and waiting and waiting.
segments.zh: 而且，CEO几个月前就宣布了，我们一直在等待。

segments.en: But the problem has gotten worse over the months. So we need to hit the ground running with a complete overhaul of a product here. And that's the main issue.
segments.zh: 但问题在几个月内承压了。所以我们需要立即行动，全面改革产品，这是主要问题。

segments.en: Yeah, and these things, what you're identifying sounds like it'll take months to fix at the very least. It's not going to be a turnaround immediately. The founder of Lululemon and key shareholder,
segments.zh: 是的，你指出的这些问题至少需要几个月才能解决，不会立即扭转。Lululemon的创始人和主要股东，

segments.en: Chip Wilson has been an irritant as well for the company criticizing strategy from the sidelines.
segments.zh: 奇普·威尔逊对公司来说也是个麻烦，他一直在场外批评公司战略。
